title: Bootstrap then unattended drain is proven live in three operator repositories
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 6 (folds t-db6tyeb): acceptance of the breakthrough.
Outcome: in scratch clones/forks of one php/wordpress, one npm and one python operator repo: adopt exit 0, first test merged via krn lane run, one real task drained by krn lane run --ready --max 2 with zero lead turns; rows in .krn/runs/outside/summary.txt.
Proof: 3 rows exit 0, graded; every failure becomes a KRN defect task. Paid: about 9 sessions.
